§6Structuralduct & Covers§f

§aHide your duct networks inside decorative blocks, because aesthetics matter!§f

§bStructuralducts§f are decorative blocks that connect to most ducts with no transfer function, but they're the crafting base for §bCovers§f.

§6Crafting§f:
§b• Structuralduct§f: §e2× Iron Nugget§f + §e1× Lead Ingot§f → §e6× Structuralduct§f.
§b• Covers§f (shapeless): §e1× Structuralduct§f + §e1× any block§f → §e6× Covers§f.

§bCovers§f install on any duct side to make it look like a full block. They don't affect functionality, ducts passing through create a hole automatically.

Available cover materials: Stone, Granite, Diorite, Andesite, Grass, Dirt, Cobblestone, all Wood Planks, Sandstone, Nether Brick, Obsidian, Moss Stone, Bricks, Polished variants, End Stone Bricks.

§eTip§f: Covers let you run transport networks inside your base's walls. The duct still works, but you'd never know it was there.
